overview.name: The Iron Legion
overview.headquarters: Mobile Command / The Iron Citadel (Location Classified)
overview.currentObjective: Destabilization of Rogueport; Elimination of Regency Loyalists

supremeCommand.name: General Grok (Presumed)
supremeCommand.description: A brilliant tactician who prioritizes strength above all. Whereabouts currently unknown, but orders are being received.

councilOfHammers.description: Advisory body of seven senior Hammer Lords. Responsible for grand strategy, resource allocation, and succession protocols. Meets weekly in the Anvil Chamber.

fieldRanks.description: Strategic commanders answering only to the Grand Forgemaster
Primary officer corps, the Legion's backbone
Squad leaders, veteran soldiers promoted from ranks
Standard infantry, the iron that makes the machine

units.name: Iron Crown Brigade
units.description: The main fighting force of the Legion.

units.name: The Iron Fists
units.description: Ruthless enforcers wearing distinctive heavy armor. Responsible for the 'Night of Knives' killing local guards.

units.name: Iron Crown Brigade
units.description: Semi-autonomous force operating under deep cover. Specializes in infiltration, propaganda, and targeted elimination. Reports directly to Hammer Lord Brennan. Currently the primary Legion presence in Kingdom territory.
units.status: ACTIVE - Recently seized control of the airship 'Vigilance'

units.name: Shadow Hammers
units.description: Elite black ops unit. Members undergo psychological conditioning and are considered expendable. Known for theatrical kills meant to send messages.
units.status: ACTIVE - Multiple confirmed operations in Kingdom

units.name: Royal Service Division
units.description: Bodyguard and security force. Also handles internal affairs and loyalty enforcement. Recently deployed to 'secure' the Vigilance.

units.name: Forge Engineers
units.description: Combat engineers responsible for siege engines, fortifications, and demolitions. Their 'Forge Engines' are feared across the Midlands.

doctrineAndTactics.title: Military Doctrine
doctrineAndTactics.corePhilosophy: The Legion fights not to win battles, but to end wars. Every engagement is designed to break the enemy's capacity and will to resist. Speed is sacrificed for certainty.

tacticalPrinciples.name: The Anvil
tacticalPrinciples.description: Holding ground with overwhelming heavy armor.

tacticalPrinciples.name: The Hammer
tacticalPrinciples.description: Rapid, crushing strikes against weakened enemy lines.

tacticalPrinciples.name: The Iron Wall
tacticalPrinciples.description: Standard defensive formation using interlocking enchanted shields. Creates near-impenetrable barriers that can advance slowly while maintaining protection. Vulnerable only to flanking or magical bombardment.

tacticalPrinciples.name: Siege Doctrine
tacticalPrinciples.description: The Legion prefers to surround, isolate, and starve enemies rather than storm fortifications. Patience is considered a virtue. Average siege duration: 6-8 weeks.

tacticalPrinciples.name: Hammer & Anvil
tacticalPrinciples.description: Classic combined-arms tactic. Infantry pins the enemy (anvil) while cavalry or reserves strike the flank (hammer). Requires numerical superiority to execute effectively.

tacticalPrinciples.name: Controlled Escalation
tacticalPrinciples.description: Violence is applied incrementally. Enemies are given opportunities to surrender at each stage. Those who refuse are made examples of.

covertTactics.name: Urban Lockdowns
covertTactics.description: Seizing control of city districts by assassinating local law enforcement at night.

covertTactics.name: False Flag Recruitment
covertTactics.description: Posing as mercenaries to move goods or intel.

covertTactics.name: The Long Game
covertTactics.description: In territories not yet conquered, the Legion plants agents years in advance. These sleepers gather intelligence, recruit sympathizers, and await activation.

covertTactics.name: Divide & Conquer
covertTactics.description: The Iron Crown Brigade excels at turning factions against each other. False flag operations, leaked intelligence, and strategic assassinations create chaos the Legion can exploit.

covertTactics.name: The Helping Hand
covertTactics.description: Legion forces often arrive as 'peacekeepers' or 'advisors' during crises they manufactured. By the time the population realizes the truth, occupation is complete.

ideology.title: The Iron Code
ideology.description: The Legion believes the Kingdom is weak and requires a 'hard reset' of governance.

tenets.meaning: Chaos is the enemy. Personal desires, moral qualms, and individual freedoms are secondary to collective stability.
A single soldier is nothing. The Legion is everything. Those who act alone threaten the whole.
Orders flow downward without question. Hesitation is weakness. Disobedience is treason.
Power justifies itself. Those who cannot hold power do not deserve it. Conquest is natural law.
A Legionnaire's life belongs to the cause. Death in service is the highest honor.
Defeated peoples are resources. They will be civilized through labor and obedience.

rituals.name: The Anvil Oath
rituals.description: Initiation ceremony where recruits are branded with the Legion sigil and swear eternal loyalty.

rituals.name: The Forge Chant
rituals.description: Daily morning recitation reinforcing Code tenets. Mandatory for all personnel.

rituals.name: Rehammering
rituals.description: Public punishment for infractions. Minor offenses result in flogging. Major violations end in execution.

rituals.name: The Iron Vigil
rituals.description: 24-hour standing watch as test of discipline. Required for promotion beyond Legionnaire.

midlandsProgram.name: The Iron Call
midlandsProgram.description: Public recruitment drives held in Midlands cities. Targets disaffected youth, unemployed laborers, and those seeking purpose. Promises of steady pay, glory, and belonging are effective lures.
process: Public rally with speeches and demonstrations
Initial screening for physical and mental fitness
Two-week 'Forge Trial' testing endurance and obedience
Six months of intensive training before assignment

kingdomProgram.name: The Secret Forge
kingdomProgram.description: Covert recruitment by the Iron Crown Brigade. Targets refugees, criminals, and those with grievances against existing factions. Emphasizes the Legion as saviors who will bring stability.
process: Small tasks to build trust and complicity
Secret oath ceremony in hidden locations
Integration into cell structure with limited knowledge

operations.description: Enforcing a total lockdown in Rogueport. Systematic elimination of independent guards and Regency patrols.
Support role in the Loyalist takeover of Toad Town.
First major confrontation with party aboard Vigilance. Legion agents attempted to recover prisoners and were detained. Revealed extent of Brigade infiltration.
operations.outcome: Partial failure - agents captured, but intelligence gathered

operations.description: Coordinated assault involving multiple faction conflicts. Legion forces engaged Tea Leaf Syndicate while pursuing primary objectives.
operations.outcome: Partial success - significant chaos created, some objectives achieved

operations.description: Attempted ambush in lava-filled sewer system. Legion spy led party into trap involving a Behir creature.
operations.outcome: Failure - party escaped, spy identity compromised

operations.description: Infiltration of Shadeward Manor during temporal anomaly event. Revealed alliance with robotic duplicate and clone assets.
operations.outcome: Mixed - Manor secured briefly, but party escaped with intelligence

operations.description: Successful boarding and capture of the airship Vigilance. Royal Service Division takes control.
Political operation. The Iron Mandate passed by Midlands Diet granting emergency powers for 'supernatural threat' elimination.
operations.outcome: SUCCESS - Legal authority for expanded operations

military.notes: Standard issue, resistant to light magic.

intelligence.notes: Sleeper cells in all major factions
Archie clone, robotic duplicate, others suspected

political.notes: Tenuous pacts with independent villain factions.

operatives.name: Legionnaire 734 (Deceased)
operatives.description: Killed by Skeleton Knight in Rogueport. Armor looted by Erick.

operatives.name: 'The Executioner'
operatives.description: Unidentified leader of the Rogueport assassination squad.

operatives.name: Viceroy Hammer Forgeheart
operatives.description: Overall commander of Kingdom operations. Ruthless and methodical. Has not been personally sighted.

operatives.name: Tribune Aldric Stone
operatives.description: Led the Vigilance boarding party. Professional soldier with no known personal grievances.

operatives.name: The Archie Clone
operatives.description: Two-eyed duplicate of Archie Miser created through forbidden necromancy. Seeks to claim Archie's third eye. Currently held by Behir creature.

operatives.name: Creek
operatives.description: Mercenary surgeon with Legion ties. Performed surgery on wounded toad, discovered to be Legion plant.

operatives.name: Unknown Spy (Sewer)
operatives.description: Led party into Behir trap. Identity never confirmed. May still be active.

operatives.name: Iron Legion Spy (Manor)
operatives.description: Assisted hjumpik in Mirror Dimension. Revealed impending Supernatural Sovereignty Act. Motivations unclear.

weaknesses.description: Heavy armor makes them slow and conductive to electrical/fire magic.
The Legion is operating far from supply lines. The Iron Crown Brigade has limited reinforcement options and must rely on local recruitment.
Heavy reliance on chain of command. Elimination of key officers can paralyze units for extended periods.
Council of Hammers contains moderate faction. If hardliners overreach, internal opposition may emerge.
Brutal tactics generate resistance. Conquered populations remain hostile and require constant suppression.
Legion has limited arcane capabilities compared to Mages' Guild or supernatural factions. Relies on captured assets and artifacts.
Act alienates Onyx Hand, Moonfang Pack, and other supernatural entities. Creates potential alliance of enemies.

factions.name: Regal Empire
factions.description: The Legion is the Empire's military arm. Mutual interests align completely.

factions.name: Peach Loyalists
factions.description: Direct opposition. Loyalists resist all Imperial expansion.

factions.name: Liberated Toads
factions.description: Party's faction. Multiple violent confrontations. High-priority targets.

factions.name: Fawful's Forces
factions.description: Nominal enemies, but conflicts may serve Legion interests by weakening Kingdom.

factions.name: Mages' Guild
factions.description: Guild resents Legion's anti-magic tendencies. Supernatural Sovereignty Act deepens rift.

factions.name: Onyx Hand
factions.description: Supernatural Sovereignty Act effectively declares war on vampire organization.

factions.name: Moonfang Pack
factions.description: Supernatural Sovereignty Act targets werewolf faction for elimination.

factions.name: Tea Leaf Syndicate
factions.description: Criminal element. Legion uses them when convenient, suppresses them otherwise.

factions.name: DK Crew
factions.description: No direct conflict. Legion monitors Kong political instability.

factions.name: Koopa Troop Remnants
factions.description: Kamek's return being watched. Potential future threat or asset.

quotes.text: An order is not a suggestion. It is a fact.
We do not raid. We conquer.
The conquered peoples are not our equals. They are raw material.
Chaos is the enemy. Order is the only virtue.
A Legionnaire's life belongs to the Emperor. Spend it wisely.
Rogueport is ours tonight. Stay inside, or stay dead.

immediateThreats: Unknown number of sleeper agents remain active
Iron Mandate grants expanded operational authority
Archie clone remains a wild card
recommendedActions: Prioritize intelligence gathering on Brigade structure
Use magic-heavy tactics against armored units.
Disrupt supply chains in the Midlands.
Identify and neutralize remaining embedded agents
Consider alliance with factions targeted by Supernatural Sovereignty Act
Develop contingency for Vigilance recovery or destruction
